hypotheses.statement: Yellow taxi trips on Thursday 28 Nov 2024 dropped significantly compared to the average of the three prior Thursdays in November 2024.
hypotheses.support_if: Trips on 2024-11-28 are at least 20% lower than the mean trips on 2024-11-07, 2024-11-14, 2024-11-21.
hypotheses.refute_if: Trips on 2024-11-28 are within 5% of the baseline Thursday average.

hypotheses.statement: Thanksgiving Day (2024-11-28) is a federal holiday that suppresses commuter and business travel, causing the trip drop.
hypotheses.support_if: whybot.us_holidays confirms 2024-11-28 is a federal holiday (Thanksgiving) and baseline Thursdays are not holidays.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2024-11-28 is not listed as a holiday, or baseline Thursdays also show holiday flags.

hypotheses.statement: Adverse weather (precipitation, cold temperatures, or snow) on 2024-11-28 reduced demand relative to the baseline Thursdays.
hypotheses.support_if: nyc_weather_daily shows prcp_mm > 5 or snow_mm > 0 or tmax_c < 5 on 2024-11-28, while baseline Thursdays have milder conditions.
hypotheses.refute_if: Weather on 2024-11-28 is similar to or better than baseline Thursdays (dry, tmax_c > 10).

hypotheses.statement: The drop is partly explained by a general Thursday vs other weekdays pattern, but the specific Thursday 28 Nov is an outlier even for Thursdays.
hypotheses.support_if: Average Thursday trips in Nov 2024 (excluding 28th) are lower than Mon-Wed but 28 Nov is still a negative outlier vs those Thursdays.
hypotheses.refute_if: 28 Nov trips are in line with the typical Thursday level for the month.

hypotheses.statement: A shift in fare composition (e.g., fewer long-distance/airport trips, more short trips) on the holiday reduced trip counts if drivers stayed off the road.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance on 2024-11-28 is materially lower than baseline Thursdays, indicating a mix shift toward shorter trips or supply withdrawal.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 are similar to baseline Thursdays.

hypotheses.statement: The apparent drop is a data artifact: missing or delayed trip records for 2024-11-28 in the TLC feed.
hypotheses.support_if: Trip count is implausibly low (e.g., < 10k) and/or avg_total_amount / avg_trip_distance are NULL or extreme outliers.
hypotheses.refute_if: Trips, avg_total_amount, avg_trip_distance on 2024-11-28 are all populated and within plausible ranges.

queries.purpose: Get daily trips, avg_total_amount, avg_trip_distance for target date 2024-11-28 and baseline Thursdays 2024-11-07, 2024-11-14, 2024-11-21 from whybot.yellow_daily.
Check whybot.us_holidays for holiday_name and is_national on 2024-11-28 and the three baseline Thursdays.
Retrieve prcp_mm, snow_mm, tmax_c, tmin_c for 2024-11-28 and the three baseline Thursdays from whybot.nyc_weather_daily.
Compute average trips for all Thursdays in November 2024 (2024-11-01 to 2024-11-30) from whybot.yellow_daily, and flag 2024-11-28 as outlier.
Compare avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 vs baseline Thursdays from whybot.yellow_daily to detect fare/distance mix shift.
Validate data quality for 2024-11-28: check trips > 0, avg_total_amount and avg_trip_distance not null, and values within historical min/max for November 2024.

plan.rationale: H0 quantifies the drop. H1 tests the Thanksgiving holiday effect (primary suspect). H2 checks weather (secondary). H3 contextualizes Thursday seasonality. H4 examines fare/distance mix as a proxy for trip-type composition. H5 rules out data gaps. All queries use only catalog tables and stay within the 2024-04-01..2025-02-28 window.

answer.answer: Trips fell to 77,244 from an average of 141,603 on other November Thursdays, a decline driven by the Thanksgiving holiday and adverse weather (21.8 mm rain, 9.4 °C max temp). Average fare also dropped 11.5% to $25.32, while average trip distance increased sharply compared to baseline Thursdays, indicating a shift in trip mix rather than simply fewer trips.
answer.recommendation: Investigate the composition of trip distances on 28 Nov versus baseline Thursdays to understand whether longer leisure or airport trips offset the holiday-related decline in overall volume. Monitor weather forecasts for future holidays to model demand shocks.
